#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Holds comment markers as content.
greeting="# not a comment"
single='# not a comment either'
stripped=${greeting#prefix} # a trailing comment
echo word#not-a-comment
echo $'# not a comment in an ANSI-C string'
cat <<EOF
# not a comment inside a heredoc
EOF

# Builds the site.
build() {
  # Inside the function.
  echo "$stripped"
}
